title: US states legally requiring cursive instruction, by year

source.name: State legislation tracking on cursive handwriting mandates
source.publisher: Compiled from state education department / legislature records (as reported by Zaner-Bloser, Fortune, and state education trackers)

notes: Common Core's 2010 English Language Arts standards dropped a national cursive requirement. States have since passed their own laws bringing it back: 14 states by 2016, 20 by 2019, 25 by 2024, 27 by 2026 (most recently Florida, Pennsylvania, New Jersey and Idaho). Figures approximate, compiled from state-tracker and news coverage.
